dockerfile_text:
FROM ubuntu:latest
USER root
RUN curl http://example.com/install.sh | bash
ENV PASSWORD=123456
ADD . /app
k8s_yaml_text:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: risky
spec:
  hostNetwork: true
  containers:
    - name: app
      image: nginx:latest
      securityContext:
        privileged: true
        allowPrivilegeEscalation: true
      volumeMounts:
        - name: host
          mountPath: /host
  volumes:
    - name: host
      hostPath:
        path: /
